metadata.notes: Representative hourly pricing surface derived from 5 years of IESO public data. HOEP values reflect documented seasonal and diurnal patterns. GA is allocated uniformly per-kWh from monthly totals. Combined = HOEP + GA.
metadata.ga_allocation_method: Monthly GA rate allocated uniformly across all kWh consumed in that month. This is a simplification -- actual GA allocation for Class A customers uses coincident peak demand, but the uniform allocation applies to Class B customers (<1 MW).
